input.missing_data_policy: EXCLUDE_NO_FILL; no forward/back fill, interpolation, or synthetic bars

calculation_method.total_return_pct: (last eligible daily close / first eligible daily close - 1) * 100; price-only
calculation_method.annualized_volatility_pct: sample standard deviation of daily close-to-close returns * sqrt(252) * 100
calculation_method.atr_pct: Wilder ATR(14) / daily close * 100; initial ATR is arithmetic mean of first 14 true ranges
calculation_method.trend_slope_log_per_session: OLS slope of log(close) against zero-based eligible trading-session index
calculation_method.positive_20d_ratio_pct: share of eligible 20-session close-to-close returns > 0; zeros in denominator but not numerator
calculation_method.negative_20d_ratio_pct: share of eligible 20-session close-to-close returns < 0; zeros in denominator but not numerator
calculation_method.reversal_10d_count: number of sign changes between consecutive non-zero 10-session close-to-close returns; zero values omitted
calculation_method.reversal_10d_rate_pct: sign change count / adjacent non-zero sign comparisons * 100
calculation_method.price_max_drawdown_pct: min(close / running maximum close - 1) * 100; buy-and-hold price series only
calculation_method.z_score: population standard deviation across the five stocks; zero if standard deviation is zero
calculation_method.flat_direction: absolute OLS slope <= 1e-12; otherwise sign of slope
